findings.claim: The change adds no test, and there is currently no test for DialogModal or for the two components that use it (AddToAddressBookModal.tsx, CustomNonceModal.tsx). A small render test would prevent someone later removing accessible={false} and merging the dialog back into one element without anyone noticing, for example by checking that the dialog-cancel and dialog-save buttons can each be found by role and label.
With accessible={false} set on the overlay, screen-reader users can no longer reach the tap-outside-to-cancel interaction, since VoiceOver can no longer see that element as tappable.
